title: Claude Skill Registry — metadata.json
description: Schema for the per-skill metadata.json sidecar that lives alongside each SKILL.md in the registry archive.

name.description: Canonical skill name. Should match the SKILL.md frontmatter `name` field.

category.description: Top-level category folder. Must match the parent category directory.

dir_name.description: On-disk directory name. Must match the basename of the directory holding metadata.json.

description.description: Short description from SKILL.md frontmatter. Strongly recommended. May be the empty string only when the upstream SKILL.md frontmatter has no description.

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the upstream skill, when known.

github_branch.description: Upstream branch name the snapshot was taken from.

github_path.description: Path inside the upstream repo where the SKILL.md lives.

path.description: Legacy field: same shape as github_path. Newer entries should prefer github_path.

branch.description: Legacy field: same shape as github_branch.

source_path.description: Legacy field: same shape as github_path.

downloaded_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the archive snapshot.

stars.description: Upstream star count at snapshot time.

license_class.description: Coarse license classification used by the registry. `compatible` = redistribution OK; `restricted` = limited redistribution; `unknown` = not yet classified.

distribution.description: Mirrors license_class for now; kept as a separate field so distribution policy can diverge from upstream license.
